title: The Twelve Gates of Cultivation
status: Canon for the rewrite. Only the opening training arc is authored in this batch; later realms are not gameplay unlocks.

protagonist.name: Lin Yue
protagonist.root: Ordinary mixed five-phase root, initially too faint to measure.
protagonist.principle: No reincarnation, secret bloodline, automatic inheritance or pendant-granted cultivation. Measured work changes what Lin Yue can sustain.

measures.breath_unit: One breath-unit is the qi needed to keep a standard copper thread illuminated for one calm exhalation. Measurements use the same thread and ambient ward; numbers cannot be compared without calibration.
measures.reserve: Usable stored qi, separately measured from structural capacity. A large empty reservoir does no work.
measures.capacity: Maximum safe reserve measured after recovery. Capacity cannot be increased by exhausting the reserve.
measures.purity: Fraction of stored qi matching the practitioner's stable cycle. High reserve at low purity can damage a meridian.
measures.strain: Accumulated pressure and fatigue. Strain rises with throughput, incompatible phases, injury and forced seals. Rest, nutrition and appropriate treatment reduce it.
measures.control: Repeatable direction, release and interruption. The ability to stop a technique is tested before its power.
measures.comprehension: An explanation demonstrated under changed conditions, rather than reciting a manual.
measures.affinity: Wood, fire, earth, metal and water are process affinities, not moral traits. Mixed roots learn slowly but permit flexible cycles.
measures.throughput: Maximum tested qi flow through a specific route per ordinary breath, separately from stored reserve. Stay below the last recovered safe result; injury or a changed instrument requires reassessment.
measures.measurement_cost: Sampling itself discharges qi. Subtract known work and measured sampling discharge from starting reserve before identifying unexplained leakage. Calibration cannot make a real energy cost disappear.

anatomy.name: Lower dantian
anatomy.function: Storage and refinement below the navel. Mortals have the anatomical locus but no stable spiritual reservoir.
anatomy.failure: Forced gathering before closure gives abdominal heat, nausea and qi leakage.

anatomy.name: Middle dantian
anatomy.function: Balances circulation with breath and heartbeat. Opened gradually during Foundation; it is not an extra free reservoir.
anatomy.failure: Premature compression causes rhythm disturbances and unreliable technique timing.

anatomy.name: Upper dantian
anatomy.function: Anchors spiritual perception and later soul formation.
anatomy.failure: Flooding it before a stable core creates false sensations and fractured attention.

anatomy.name: Twelve primary meridians: six paired routes
anatomy.function: Twelve primary channels form six inward/outward pairs through limbs and trunk. Body Tempering prepares tissue and uses external practice leads; Qi Gathering opens internal pairs in sequence. The first arm pair is earned at stage 3. A chest junction on that route is not an opened middle dantian.
anatomy.failure: One strong route cannot compensate for a damaged partner.

anatomy.name: Eight extraordinary vessels
anatomy.function: Distribute surplus, bridge the paired meridians and regulate the small and great heavenly circuits.
anatomy.failure: Opening all at once produces crossflow. Each bridge must close cleanly before another opens.

anatomy.name: Spiritual root
anatomy.function: A conversion pattern that admits ambient qi. It influences efficiency, not worth, intelligence or entitlement.
anatomy.failure: Root tests can read environmental noise. Three sessions with a blank and calibrated stone are required.

cycle.name: Prepare
cycle.rule: Eat, recover, inspect injuries and calibrate the practice room. A depleted body cannot substitute determination for fuel.

cycle.name: Sense
cycle.rule: Distinguish ambient qi from pulse, warmth and breath. Use a blank instrument and repeat after the instrument is removed.

cycle.name: Admit
cycle.rule: Draw a measured trace through the root. Begin below the safe load measured that week.

cycle.name: Refine
cycle.rule: Separate compatible qi from grit and mismatched phases. Purification consumes time and fuel.

cycle.name: Circulate
cycle.rule: Guide the trace through established paired routes. Never force a blocked channel with added pressure.

cycle.name: Store
cycle.rule: Close the circuit into the lower dantian; record retained reserve after ordinary walking.

cycle.name: Release
cycle.rule: Discharge safely into a grounded practice wick. The exit stroke is learned before the entry stroke.

cycle.name: Recover
cycle.rule: Measure next-day tremor, pain, sleep and retention. The next attempt depends on recovery, not a daily streak.

realms.name: Mortal
realms.mechanism: No retained qi; ordinary food, tools and muscles perform work.
realms.admission: Lin Yue begins here, with zero reserve and no reliable spiritual sensation.
realms.practice: Posture, literacy, breath without retention, load management and observation. A sensation that cannot survive a blank comparison is recorded as uncertain.
realms.breakthrough: Enter Body Tempering only after repeatable ordinary exercises, healed practice injuries and a stable rhythm under load.
realms.capabilities: Ordinary craft, travel, sword drills and study. No qi technique, flight, ward binding or spiritual healing.
realms.limits: Being stubborn does not create qi. A gift or auspicious object cannot perform the required exercises.
realms.failure: Dehydration, overwork and confusing a racing pulse with spiritual perception.
realms.recovery: Food, water, sleep, reduced work and treatment when needed.

realms.name: Body Tempering
realms.mechanism: Prepare tissue to withstand a future circuit using graded ordinary loads and carefully supervised external washes.
realms.admission: Mortal conditioning is repeatable and the aspirant can release tension before pain changes their gait.
realms.practice: Skin: repeated friction and recovery. Sinew: aligned load and deliberate release. Bone: progressive support without impact shortcuts. Marrow: circulation and rest through a whole workday.
realms.breakthrough: Complete four assessments over separate recovered days, sense qi reliably, admit and cleanly release a trace through an external grounded practice lead, and retain three breath-units overnight on three recovered tests without tremor. This does not open an internal meridian pair; that is earned at Qi Gathering stage 3.
realms.capabilities: Greater endurance, controlled falls and a steady training stance. External medicinal qi does not become personal reserve.
realms.limits: No sword aura, ward command or healing others. Stage names describe demonstrated resilience, not indestructibility.
realms.failure: Hidden fractures, damaged tendons, toxic washes and missing meals. Pain is a reason to inspect, not proof of progress.
realms.recovery: Step back to the last tolerated load; repair takes weeks or months and can reduce capacity.

realms.name: Qi Gathering
realms.mechanism: Admit, refine and retain ambient qi in the lower dantian.
realms.admission: Three breath-units retained overnight on three tests, clean release and no next-day tremor.
realms.practice: Early stages stabilize a trace; middle stages balance six paired channels; late stages bridge governing and conception vessels before the great circuit. Record usable reserve separately from purity. Stage 2 requires six usable breath-units after an ordinary day and sleep, at least 80% compatible charge, clean discharge, and three recovered calibrated trials. Stage 3 requires twelve usable units, at least 85% compatibility, a first paired inward/outward route carrying a quarter-unit pulse with controlled interruption, three recovered trials and normal next-day sensation. These are Azure Cloud method thresholds, not a universal currency conversion. First-pair pulse delivery may spend a half-unit to do a quarter-unit of useful work.
realms.breakthrough: Ninth stage, at least 90% compatible purity, a great circuit that survives interrupted breath, and three separate stable compression trials under supervision.
realms.capabilities: Stage 1 lights a wick briefly; stage 3 reinforces one prepared movement; stage 6 maintains a small talisman; stage 9 sustains a local ward relay.
realms.limits: Early stages cannot fly, shatter a mountain or cure an injury. Qi reserve must be replenished. Wards amplify a permitted input but cannot remove their fuel budget.
realms.failure: Leakage, phase grit, reflux at a bridge and overconfidence after the first successful trace.
realms.recovery: Safe discharge, channel rest, compatible food and low-load recirculation. A damaged route can make a former stage temporarily unusable.
realms.span: Healthy practice may reach roughly 120 years; injury and ordinary disease still matter.

realms.name: Foundation Establishment
realms.mechanism: Condense gaseous qi into a liquid reservoir anchored to balanced extraordinary vessels.
realms.admission: All Qi Gathering breakthrough tests, a prepared grounding circle and fuel for three days of supervised recovery.
realms.practice: Platform stabilizes liquid droplets; Pillars bind the eight vessel bridges one at a time; Joined foundation transfers load across all bridges without cracking the reservoir.
realms.breakthrough: Hold a circulating liquid reservoir through sleeping, walking and interrupted practice for ninety recovered days; formulate a stable core seed with a named compatible method.
realms.capabilities: Sustained reinforcement, a short supported glide using a prepared artifact, durable local arrays and limited spiritual perception.
realms.limits: Artifact flight consumes its own fuel and the user's control. Foundation is not Golden Core, even with an expensive pill.
realms.failure: Unequal pillars, borrowed incompatible qi and cracks hidden by sedatives.
realms.recovery: Rebuild the damaged pillar, sometimes returning to gaseous reserve. A Foundation pill assists condensation but cannot supply control.
realms.span: Approximately 180–250 healthy years, subject to method and injury.

realms.name: Golden Core
realms.mechanism: Crystallize the liquid reservoir around a personal stable circulation law.
realms.admission: Joined foundation and ninety-day stability; compatible core seed, recovery reserve and a protected site for the nine turns.
realms.practice: Each turn increases coherence while expelling grit. Crack inspection follows every turn. The ninth seals a repeating cycle without external pressure.
realms.breakthrough: A sealed core that sustains its own circulation, accurate spiritual reflection and a prepared soul cradle. Pass a three-part core tribulation testing load, control and contradiction.
realms.capabilities: Independent short flight, stronger arrays, sustained sword aura and perception across a bounded landscape.
realms.limits: A core does not produce unlimited qi. Rushed or cracked cores limit throughput. Core quality is coherence and repairability, not color or social prestige.
realms.failure: Core cracking, runaway heat or choosing a law one can recite but cannot maintain under conflict.
realms.recovery: Unload the core, bind cracks, rebuild turns. Shattering can end cultivation; survival does not guarantee restoration.

realms.name: Nascent Soul
realms.mechanism: Form a spiritual self supported by the core and upper dantian without consuming ordinary identity.
realms.admission: Sealed core, soul cradle and stable reflection; separate understanding of copied memory versus lived personhood.
realms.practice: Cradle aligns attention; Awakening sustains coherent perception outside one sensory channel; Embodiment returns perception reliably to the body.
realms.breakthrough: Maintain three independent soul tasks without losing recall or bodily control; survive a mirror trial confronting a real unresolved contradiction.
realms.capabilities: Brief soul projection, remote sensing through an established anchor and coordinated multiple techniques.
realms.limits: Projection leaves the body vulnerable and drains reserve. Memory echoes do not create extra souls. A destroyed body cannot be replaced casually.
realms.failure: Anchor severance, false doubles, overstretched attention and projection beyond the known return range.
realms.recovery: Withdraw projection, restore anchors and rehearse a single task. Lost spiritual structure may remain lost.

realms.name: Spirit Transformation
realms.mechanism: Bring body, core and soul into one repeatable response to a chosen environmental principle.
realms.admission: Embodied Nascent Soul, a comprehended principle and stable return from projection.
realms.practice: Study the principle under hostile conditions; gradually align bodily channels, core cycle and soul attention. Contradictory conditions are measured explicitly.
realms.breakthrough: Demonstrate a principle that still functions when its favored environment is removed; establish a bounded domain seed.
realms.capabilities: Change an existing process within an area: guide rain already present, carry an existing sound or redirect available heat.
realms.limits: No creation from nothing, absolute mind control or universal immunity. Range and expenditure grow together.
realms.failure: Environmental dependence, eroded personal perception and bodily mismatch.
realms.recovery: Separate the aligned systems, relearn ordinary sensation and repair one interface at a time.

realms.name: Void Refinement
realms.mechanism: Refine the limits between local spaces using known paired anchors.
realms.admission: True spirit and a domain seed that can be closed without abandoning an active technique.
realms.practice: Boundary measures distance through the domain; Passage joins two prepared anchors; Return closes the seam and accounts for every traveler and consumed anchor.
realms.breakthrough: Three maintained passages across changing conditions, no unresolved seam, and a fully embodied domain boundary.
realms.capabilities: Short anchored spatial travel, protected storage spaces and greater domain control.
realms.limits: Unknown destinations cannot be selected safely. A passage consumes prepared anchors; storage is not infinite or outside time.
realms.failure: Seam collapse, anchor drift, trapped technique load and returning to an altered site.
realms.recovery: Ground the seam, recover the nearest intact anchor and rebuild local distance measurements.

realms.name: Integration
realms.mechanism: Integrate the practitioner with a bounded domain while keeping exits and independent identity intact.
realms.admission: Void Return and a closed domain whose upkeep the practitioner can actually fund.
realms.practice: Body-domain shares physical load; Soul-domain shares perception; Whole domain balances both during conflict and deliberate withdrawal.
realms.breakthrough: Sustain the domain through a seasonal cycle, release every borrowed resource cleanly and identify a flaw that cannot be solved by more power.
realms.capabilities: Large coordinated arrays, controlled weather within measured bounds and defense across an inhabited region.
realms.limits: A domain still needs fuel. People within it retain independent wills. Borrowed land or labor can be withdrawn.
realms.failure: Domain dependence, concealed resource debt and carrying more territory than the core can release.
realms.recovery: Shrink the boundary, repay loads and restore bodily independence before expanding again.

realms.name: Mahayana
realms.mechanism: Hold a consistent principle across body and domain without relying on a single favorable world condition.
realms.admission: Whole domain, seasonal stability and a concrete acknowledged flaw.
realms.practice: Resolve the flaw through changed action; test the law in another region and with independent observers. A convenient explanation cannot replace a changed technique.
realms.breakthrough: A mature law, ordinary-world obligations accounted for and a prepared route through the ninefold ascension trial.
realms.capabilities: Vast but bounded transformations of existing processes and long-range anchored travel.
realms.limits: Law is not omnipotence. Contradictory laws and unavailable resources still impose limits.
realms.failure: Brittle law, hidden exceptions and treating domination as comprehension.
realms.recovery: Withdraw the law, rebuild its premise and accept a smaller domain when necessary.

realms.name: Tribulation Crossing
realms.mechanism: Reconcile the mature law with a world that cannot absorb unlimited spiritual load.
realms.admission: Mature Mahayana law, a protected trial site, evacuation plan and an ascension path with known return limits.
realms.practice: Nine distinct trials test endurance, circulation, identity, boundaries, contradiction, debts, independence, closure and transition. Earlier damage changes later trials.
realms.breakthrough: Complete all nine while protecting bystanders and closing abandoned domain anchors; ascension changes the energy environment, not the person's moral worth.
realms.capabilities: Brief contact with immortal qi and preparation for the environmental transition.
realms.limits: No sudden victory by shouting conviction. External protectors may shelter bystanders but cannot complete personal tests.
realms.failure: Burned anchors, law rupture, loss of core coherence and leaving harmful loads behind.
realms.recovery: Survive and rebuild at the last sustainable realm; some wounds or failed transitions are permanent.
realms.span: No additional guaranteed years while crossing.

realms.name: True Immortal
realms.mechanism: Rebuild mortal circulation for a denser immortal environment while preserving a coherent identity.
realms.admission: Completed ascension with closed former anchors and enough compatible reserve to survive adaptation.
realms.practice: Admit immortal qi in traces, inspect changed channels and rebuild a stable closed circuit. The first immortal day returns Lin Yue to careful measurement.
realms.breakthrough: This manuscript ends at an established immortal path; further realms remain outside its canon.
realms.capabilities: Immortal circulation and lifespan without ordinary senescence while the core and soul remain coherent.
realms.limits: Violence, resource starvation, spiritual injury and mistakes can still kill. Ascension does not resurrect the dead or erase past consequences.
realms.failure: Immortal qi contamination, adaptation shock and assuming old capacity measurements still apply.
realms.recovery: Shelter, compatible fuel, reduced intake and a rebuilt calibration protocol.
realms.span: Indefinite potential, conditional on continued coherence and survival.

techniques.name: Empty Bowl Breath
techniques.steps: Relax the jaw; breathe normally; observe pulse without holding air; stop when dizzy.
techniques.growth: Provides reproducible calm; never grants a realm by itself.

techniques.name: Copper Wick Admission
techniques.steps: Calibrate a blank copper thread; admit a trace; ground it through a release stroke; measure after walking.
techniques.cost: Practice wick, supervised time and recovered physical strength.
techniques.growth: Proves repeatable sensing and closure before Qi Gathering.

techniques.name: Reed-Step Reinforcement
techniques.steps: Inspect the rated cuff-to-sole conducting stitch; align knee and hip ordinarily; circulate the first arm pair into the external cuff; reinforce one prepared step through the sole; discharge before turning. This does not imply an unopened leg channel is usable.
techniques.cost: One measured quarter-unit of useful support plus current delivery loss, tested route throughput, a prepared conducting stitch and ordinary strength.
techniques.failure: Reinforcing a twisted knee worsens injury.
techniques.growth: Later stages permit repeated steps through additional opened pairs.

techniques.name: Nine-Turn Sword Thread
techniques.steps: Project a controlled qi edge through a grounded blade; begin below the last inspected turn's throughput.
techniques.cost: Core reserve proportional to edge length and duration.
techniques.failure: A damaged turn reflects load into the sword arm.
techniques.growth: Power improves through coherent turns and edge control, not multiplying named attacks.

techniques.name: Returning Lantern Anchor
techniques.steps: Set a known return lantern; project one sensory task; verify the body remains supported; return before reserve crosses its floor.
techniques.cost: Prepared lantern, soul attention and reserve.
techniques.failure: An extinguished anchor makes the return uncertain.
techniques.growth: Additional tasks demand independent control and measured safe range.

crafts.name: Alchemy
crafts.rule: Ingredients carry compatible phases, contaminants and finite potency. A pill assists a process whose control is already learned; tolerance, toxicity and recovery are recorded.
crafts.opening_use: Lin Yue can wash vessels and identify ingredients before handling spiritual fire.

crafts.name: Talisman craft
crafts.rule: A stroke specifies direction, load and release. Pigment and backing limit throughput. Copying the entry stroke without the release stroke creates a trap.
crafts.opening_use: Mortal copying exercises teach the release stroke with ordinary ink.

crafts.name: Array craft
crafts.rule: Nodes distribute load through anchors, fuel and operators. Every array needs rated capacity, failure isolation and a shutdown path.
crafts.opening_use: The mountain crisis uses an existing array; Lin Yue contributes one small grounded relay.

crafts.name: Artifact forging
crafts.rule: Material purity, vessel geometry and inscription compatibility determine ratings. An artifact's stored energy never becomes the user's realm.
crafts.opening_use: A dull practice sword remains useful for alignment.

crafts.name: Beast cultivation
crafts.rule: Spirit beasts have species-specific channels, diets and advancement trials. Their cores are not consequence-free human pills; peaceful teaching and trade are viable routes.
crafts.opening_use: A furnace mite is dangerous through hot grit, not because it matches a human realm exactly.

resources.name: Ordinary grain
resources.limit: Missing meals slows training; spirit stones do not replace nutrition.

resources.name: Low-grade spirit stone
resources.limit: Finite stored energy, impurities and regional prices. No fixed conversion from money to personal realm.

resources.name: Channel wash
resources.limit: Dose depends on tissue tolerance; an expensive wash can still injure.

resources.name: Foundation reagent
resources.use: Assist liquid condensation after all control tests.
resources.limit: Provides compatible material, not the foundation's bridges.

resources.name: Recovery reserve
resources.use: Food, treatment, accommodation and fuel after a breakthrough.
resources.limit: Spending every resource on the attempt can make a technically successful breakthrough unsustainable.

combat: Compare realm, stable stage, reserve, injury, terrain, preparation and willingness to sustain the cost. Large realm gaps matter; clever plans can permit escape or a specific local success, not routine unexplained victories.
gameplay_contract: Qi, Trust, Insight and Resolve remain choice attributes. Their numerical ranks are not cultivation realms. Current realm is authored scene metadata; no threshold in those attributes grants a realm. This batch adds an in-game reference codex, not a complete resource simulation.
editorial_contract: Every breakthrough needs prior practice, a measured test, a cost, a failure possibility and recovery scenes. Show elapsed seasons and livelihood. No technique should gain unexplained range between scenes.
